characters.dialogue.sam.14: Ufff, pisé algo del asco denante... y me acabo de comprar estas zapatillas.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.acceptbirthdaygi: Hey, hey, hey! ¡Te acordas--$h#$b#...*Olisquea*... ¿A qué huele...?$8#$b#...Oh.$5
¡Ey, ey, ey! ¡Te acordaste! ¡Esto sí es un regalo!$h
characters.dialogue.sam.acceptgift_(o)st: Ohhh... 'Pera... ¿es pa' mí? ¡Nunca me imaginé que me darías algo así! ¡Gracias!
characters.dialogue.sam.breakup: Qué... ¡¿cómo?!$8#$b#Pensé que estábamos bien... Supongo que no te puse atención... Está bien.$9#$b#Sí, dale... podemos seguir como amigos.$9
characters.dialogue.sam.dating_sam_memor: I couldn't sleep last night. I was imagining all the things we're gonna do together.$10
characters.dialogue.sam.dating_sebastian: Caché que están tú y el Seba... ¡más le vale seguir viniendo a practicar con la banda como siempre!
characters.dialogue.sam.divorced: Lo siento, @. No creo que pueda seguir siendo tu amigo.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.event_band1: Oye, ¿sabís qué? Estaba pensando en ese mismo estilo... para la banda.
characters.dialogue.sam.event_band2: Oye, ¿sabís qué? Estaba pensando en ese mismo estilo... para la banda.
characters.dialogue.sam.event_band3: Oye, ¿sabís qué? Estaba pensando en ese mismo estilo... para la banda.
characters.dialogue.sam.event_band4: Oye, ¿sabís qué? Estaba pensando en ese mismo estilo... para la banda.
characters.dialogue.sam.event_room2: Sí... ¡Definitivamente, eso fue lo que pasó!
characters.dialogue.sam.event_snack1: Es verdad... Eso fue lo que pasó.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.event_snack2: Sí... ¡Definitivamente, eso fue lo que pasó!
characters.dialogue.sam.eventseen_408114: Ufff, incluso habiendo practicado tanto, me equivoqueé varias veces en el show... Ojalá no se haya notado tanto.$s#$e#¡Es bien estresante estar en frente de todo!$h
characters.dialogue.sam.eventseen_45: Mejor pasar piola por un tiempo. ¡Y no tener de malas al alcalde!
characters.dialogue.sam.eventseen_45_mem: Sería bacán que hubiera un skate park en el pueblo, ¿cierto?#$b#Pero, ¿cómo convencer al alcalde?$s
characters.dialogue.sam.eventseen_733330: Si... O sea, CUANDO... mi papá vuelva, ¿será el mismo que yo recuerdo?$s
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_14: Hola, @.#$e#Emmm.. ¿Podré hacer crecer un cactus en mi pieza?
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_16: ¡Pedí unas zapatillas por internet hace como una semana! Loco, se han demora'o caleta.#$e#Parece que sí vivimos en medio de la nada.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_23: Ah, se sienten bien las zapatillas nuevas en los pies. Están un poco tiesas, pero ya se van a acomodar. Sobre todo cuando corra por el laberinto el fin de semana.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_26: Marrato, a la noche 'noche', cuando estén todos dormidos, el viejo raro que vive en el bosque va a armar el laberinto. Nunca deja que nadie lo vea trabajar.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_9: Pedí unas zapatillas nuevas por internet. Son iguales que estas, así que me van a quedar bien.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_fri: Antes vivía en Zuzu, esa ciudad grande. Lo que más cambia es el ruido. Nunca se duerme en la ciudad.#$e#Hay mucha gente por todos lados, todo el tiempo. Y siempre está brillante por todas las luces, sobre todo de noche.#$e#Supongo que el que te guste o no, dependerá de tu personalidad.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_fri10: Creo que me ha empezado a gustar más el campo que la ciudad.$h#$b#Aunque puede que esté sesgado... por alguna razón.$10#$e#Bueno, ¿cómo vas hoy día?$h
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_mon: Oh, wena. ¿Ya te has amigado con alguien del pueblo?#$e#Chau.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_mon2: I like taking walks in the forest this time of year. The temperature is so comfortable.#$e#...$h
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_sat: Hmm. I think I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_sat4: I'm lucky to have the biggest room in the house to myself.#$e#I guess there's advantages to being the oldest child.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_sun: It's hard to have fun on Sunday... I keep thinking about having to go to work tomorrow.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_sun8: The first week of fall is already over. Man, that went by fast.$s#$e#Whatever. I'm just happy that you came to visit me!#$e#So do you have anything new to tell me?
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_thu: Did you ever notice all the spider webs that appear during the fall?#$e#If you get up early you'll see them covered in dew... like little stars.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_thu6: I guess I should start thinking about moving out soon...$s#$e#...But I would miss Mom's fish casserole, so I dunno...$s#$e#I hate making decisions.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_thu6_1: I think my Dad might be coming back next year.#$e#I guess that's kind of soon. Weird.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_tue: My shoes always seem to wear out this time of year. Look, my toe's poking through!$h#$e#That's what happens when you skateboard too much.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_tue4: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Just stop by whenever you want.
characters.dialogue.sam.fall_wed: Hey... something smells good, like pizza.#$e#Do you smell that? Maybe Mom's cooking something.
characters.dialogue.sam.firstvisit_sewer: Heheh... So you've been to the sewer, huh? I've snuck down there a few times myself. It's pretty creepy.#$e#How could I tell? Hmm... let's just say... 'the nose knows'.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.flowerdance_acce: Oh... with me? Hehe... Yeah, sure. Sounds fun!$10
Aw, I gotta put on that dorky suit again? I thought now that we're married... Well, alright.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.flowerdance_decl: Hmm... I dunno. Maybe next year.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.fri: Did I ever tell you we used to live in the city?#$e#There's a lot more stuff going on, but it's also kinda noisy and hectic... It's hard to say which is better.
characters.dialogue.sam.fri10: The older I get the more attached I feel to the valley.#$b#Although I could be biased... for a certain reason.$10#$e#So, how are you doing today?$h
characters.dialogue.sam.fri4: Dad used to work as a garbage man in the city.#$e#You don't even want to know some of the things he found in people's trash.
characters.dialogue.sam.greenrain: Whaa! Is it acid? Will it burn through the roof and sizzle us alive?$8#$b#I gotta keep my little brother safe!$7
characters.dialogue.sam.greenrain_2: You notice how warm this rain is? It feels alive...
characters.dialogue.sam.greenrainfinishe: Seems like there's no damage to anything... That was a strange one. How are you holding up?
characters.dialogue.sam.introduction: Hey, I'm Sam. Good to meet you.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.married_abigail: Hey, what's the big idea? You took my drummer!$8#$b#Haha, just kidding... Congrats!$h
characters.dialogue.sam.married_sebastia: Wow, I can't believe you and Sebastian got hitched. Times really are changing...$u#$e#Eh, it's alright, I'm sure he'll still have time to hang out.
characters.dialogue.sam.mon2: Hey, how's it going?#$e#Last night I practiced guitar for 4 hours straight. My fingers hurt like crazy.$s#$e#Bye, I've got something to do...
characters.dialogue.sam.mon8: I'll tell you a secret... my name 'Sam' is short for 'Samson'.$10#$e#Most people don't know that so keep it on mute.
characters.dialogue.sam.resort: I bet there's some cool stuff deeper on the island.#$e#Willy said we have to stay here, though... some kind of liability issues or something.$s
characters.dialogue.sam.resort_bar: I'm just getting juiced up, then it's back to the beach.
characters.dialogue.sam.resort_leaving: I'm feeling pretty good from all the sunlight.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.resort_shore: Check out these gnarly waves... Guess what? I'm gonna save up for a surfboard.
characters.dialogue.sam.resort_towel: %Sam is playing a jazzy tune on his guitar.
characters.dialogue.sam.resort_towel_2: Maybe I should learn to play the ukulele.#$e#Abby on the congas and Sebastian on the steel drums... 'The Pelicans of Paradise'...$s#$e#What's the matter, you look worried.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.sat: Hmm. I just remembered that I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
characters.dialogue.sam.sat4: Oh! I just remembered I'm supposed to call my Grandma. Okay, I'm going to put this rubber band on my wrist so I don't forget.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.secondchance_guy: Alright, I'm done with the cold shoulder act. Let's just forget about what happened.$7
characters.dialogue.sam.spring_12: My little brother gets so excited for festivals. He's been talking about tomorrow's egg hunt all day.
characters.dialogue.sam.spring_21: Sometimes those spring petals that float around make my nose drip.$s#$e#I like summer best, myself.
characters.dialogue.sam.spring_23: Why couldn't the flower dance be today so I could get work off?$s
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_10: I don't have to work tomorrow! I've never been so happy.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_fri: You know... I used to live in the city and I have to admit, this place is much nicer in the summer.$h#$e#The city is so hot with all that concrete.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_mon: There's a little less pollen in the summer... my nose is really happy.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_mon2: Hey, how's it going?#$e#I'm hungry.#$e#See you later.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_mon6: Have you been to the desert yet?#$e#You can find some interesting things there. Dad took me a couple times when I was younger.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_sun: When you see hot air balloons drifting over the sea, you'll know that summer's in full swing.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_thu: Dad was telling me about our national enemy, the Gotoro Empire... They sound like a ruthless bunch.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_thu6_2: Sometimes I can hear my Dad pacing down the hallway at night.$s#$b#...But he won't tell us what's troubling him.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_tue: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Goodbye for now.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_tue4: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#I'm so energized during summer I hardly have to sleep!
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_wed: Hi. Taking the day off?#$e#Sounds interesting.
characters.dialogue.sam.summer_wed2: I saw a spider on my ceiling last night. They sure like the warmth.#$e#I hope he didn't crawl into my mouth while I was asleep...$s
characters.dialogue.sam.sun: Oh, it's a nice day... isn't it?
characters.dialogue.sam.sun8: Sometimes I wonder if my mother is actually happy with her life...$s#$e#I asked her once and got the feeling she was hiding some inner pain.
characters.dialogue.sam.thu: The clouds look great this time of year, don't they?#$e#Like scoops of vanilla ice cream floating on blue raspberry sauce... Or maybe I'm just hungry.
characters.dialogue.sam.thu2: My Dad is a soldier, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here...#$e#He'll come back someday.#$e#...I've heard some terrible things about the Gotoro Empire...$s
characters.dialogue.sam.thu2_2: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
characters.dialogue.sam.thu6_1: I think my Dad might be coming back in a year or so.#$e#I guess you might be able to meet him, then. If you're still living here.#$e#You wouldn't abandon the farm after putting so much effort into it!
characters.dialogue.sam.thu6_2: ...I have mixed feelings about my father being back. He seems strange.$s#$b#But I guess I haven't seen him in 3 years... so that could explain it.
characters.dialogue.sam.thu_2: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
characters.dialogue.sam.thu_3: *sigh*... what am I still doing here?
characters.dialogue.sam.tue: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
characters.dialogue.sam.tue4: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Sleeping feels nice but sometimes I wish I could skip it... it's just such a time-waster.
characters.dialogue.sam.wed: I'm trying to come up with a new song for my band, but I'm blanking...#$q 19/20 Wed_old#Hey.. What do you think my new song should be about?#$r 20 30 Wed_20#Farming, mining, and chopping wood.#$r 8820 30 Wed_20#A city in the sea.#$r 8821 30 Wed_20#Trains.#$r 19 -50 Wed_19#Choose anything. It'll still be a horrible song.
characters.dialogue.sam.wed10: Hey buddy. You look like you're full of energy today!^@. Um... I just wanted to say... You look nice today.$10
characters.dialogue.sam.wed6: I've been friends with Sebastian for a while. He's a pretty cool guy.#$e#If you two weren't around I wouldn't really have any friends in town.
characters.dialogue.sam.wed_19: Hey, man... what the heck is your problem? Sorry I asked.$a
characters.dialogue.sam.wed_20: Hey, you know what? That sounds perfect. Thanks!$h
characters.dialogue.sam.wed_old: $p 19#But I already know what you think about it.$a|Thanks to your help I'm already done with the lyrics!$h
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_24: The Feast of the Winter Star is supposed to be a time to show gratitude for all the good things in life.#$b#Me? I'm mostly interested in the food. Hehe.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_7: One time, Gus fell in the river during the Ice Festival. We had to build a huge fire in the saloon to dry him out.#$e#We were all worried we'd never taste his famous spaghetti ever again.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_fri: The worst thing about the snow is getting your feet soaked. You're lucky in those thick boots.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_mon2: Everyone's indoors during the winter, so I can play guitar as loud as I want.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_sat4: I just remembered I need to change the strings on my guitar.#$b#Okay, I'm going to write a note on my wrist so I remember to do it tonight.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_sun: Try not to make a mess in the house or my Mom will flip.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_sun8: It would be fun if we could go sledding, wouldn't it?#$e#I don't think there are any good hills nearby.$s#$e#Plus, I don't have a sled.#$e#So, how have you been doing lately?
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_thu: My Dad is in the military, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here.#$e#He's coming back soon, though.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_thu6: Dad's been back for a while now. I guess I'm finally getting used to it.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_thu6_1: I think my Dad is coming back this spring.#$e#It's been 3 years since I've seen him. This is going to be strange.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_thu_2: One thing that's nice about winter... all the mosquitos are gone.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_tue: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_tue4: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Well, it's a good time of year to catch up on all the sleep I've missed.$h
characters.dialogue.sam.winter_wed: $d Joja#I hate working at JojaMart, but how else am I going to make money in this town?|I'm glad I work at the museum now. It's way more interesting than that depressing JojaMart ever was.
